gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-epilogue: Happy Monkey draws every line with ruler-straight consistency, its wide-open e giving headings a bold, slightly cartoonish stamp. And Epilogue follows in a plain sans with curvy, loose letters and a tall-bodied lowercase that feels friendly and current.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans has a larger-than-usual x-height and curves that open wide at both ends, with no thick and thin shifts at all. Happy Monkey's display swagger sits above it, and Fira Sans keeps the text clear and sturdy underneath.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-merriweather-sans: One uniform stroke thickness runs through every Happy Monkey letter, which gives the headings their bold, distinctive look. But Merriweather Sans is tall and sturdy in the lowercase, with an open e, so its words feel large and sure beneath.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-public-sans: Confident and bold, Happy Monkey traces its letters like a laser-etched line. Public Sans does the opposite job, a hefty, trustworthy sans whose broad open counters carry the text while the heading font grabs attention.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-ranade: Happy Monkey bends each letter as if from one length of tubing, bold and unmistakable at heading size. And Ranade, a sans-serif with a gentle pencil-like taper and widely spaced type, does the quieter work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, with a thick, heavy-looking band of text and letters held open rather than curled shut. But Happy Monkey is the one that grabs the eye, drawing each glyph with one simple tip, while Supreme handles the steady reading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-general-sans: General Sans is a sans-serif with steady pen pressure and an x-height that fills the line, so every bend feels smooth. And over a longer passage that fullness keeps the text moving easily, while Happy Monkey stays up top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-orbit: Orbit's curves stop short instead of closing, and each character floats apart, with rope-like consistency in every stem. Happy Monkey's display heading and this sans-serif make a bold, distinctive duo.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic is a sans-serif with far-apart stroke ends and no thick and thin parts, so you read one letter at a time. And its approachable manner is the pair's strongest quality, set against Happy Monkey's bold, ruler-straight lines.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-syncopate: Happy Monkey's ruler-straight line weight and wide-gapped e make headings look bold and unmistakably its own. Give Syncopate, a plain sans with rope-ladder spacing, a little extra size.
